card.fires_on: The last noun of a multi-word technical or clinical noun phrase, such as concentration, dose, impairment, assay or agreement. It fires right where the phrase could end, often before a comma, parenthesis or new clause.

modes.label: Other compound noun phrases
modes.description: A final noun in a non-drug phrase, such as a body structure, grammar topic or software feature.
